can_do_goal: I can point to and say weather words.
kp_focus: VOC: weather words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
repair_focus: Point to one weather picture. Say the weather word.

can_do_goal: I can say It's sunny and It's rainy.
kp_focus: CHK: It's ...; VOC: sunny/rainy; RDG/LST: simple sentence recognition
vocabulary_focus: It's sunny. | It's rainy. | sunny | rainy
repair_focus: Choose one window picture. Say: It's sunny. or It's rainy.

can_do_goal: I can say It's windy and It's cloudy.
kp_focus: CHK: It's ...; VOC: windy/cloudy; LST/RDG weather recognition
vocabulary_focus: It's windy. | It's cloudy. | windy | cloudy
repair_focus: Point to the window. Say: It's windy. or It's cloudy.

kp_focus: VOC: clothes words; LST: listen and point; SP: repeat single words
vocabulary_focus: coat | hat | boots | T-shirt | shoes | umbrella | jacket | sweater
repair_focus: Choose one clothes picture. Say the clothes word.

can_do_goal: I can choose clothes for the weather.
kp_focus: MED: choose for weather; CHK: Choose ...; VOC weather/clothes
vocabulary_focus: choose | coat | boots | hat | T-shirt | umbrella | sunny | rainy
repair_focus: Look at one weather picture. Choose clothes for it.

can_do_goal: I can help a friend choose clothes.
kp_focus: SI/MED: help a friend; CHK: Choose ... for ...; review weather/clothes
vocabulary_focus: friend | choose | coat | boots | hat | umbrella | shoes
repair_focus: Help Mia, Leo, or Emma. Say one short choice.

can_do_goal: I can make a simple weather choice card.
kp_focus: PRJ: Weather Choice Card; SP/WRT: short project model; review It's ... + choose ...
vocabulary_focus: weather card | sunny | rainy | windy | cloudy | choose | coat | hat | boots | umbrella
repair_focus: Make your card. Say the weather and one clothes choice.
